findings.name: librosa.display.cmap / specshow (0.11)
findings.claim: librosa's canonical sequential colormap for dB-scaled data is magma.
findings.design_implication: Magma is the MIR convention, but the one VLM measurement (finding 2) scored it below viridis: viridis default, magma alternate, both exposed.

findings.name: librosa.amplitude_to_db (0.11)
findings.claim: amplitude_to_db defaults to ref=1.0, top_db=80, thresholding 80 dB below the peak.
findings.design_implication: Clip 80 dB below peak and normalise per image.

findings.name: Sonic Visualiser: A Brief Reference (4.5) - log-frequency spectrogram axis
findings.claim: The log-frequency spectrogram replaces the numeric y-axis with a stylised piano keyboard, every octave's C shaded.
findings.design_implication: Draw a keyboard strip with C shading instead of Hz ticks.

findings.name: Sonic Visualiser: A Brief Reference (4.5) - layers
findings.claim: Layers stack like a graphics application: spectrogram at the back, notes and onsets in front.
findings.design_implication: Overlaying the piano roll and beat grid on the spectrogram is the established MIR idiom.

findings.name: Acoustic spectral feedback in vocal learning: a systematic review of psychological mechanisms and skill outcomes
findings.claim: Spectrogram displays for vocal learning are thinly evidenced next to simple pitch-trajectory displays; recommended as auxiliary observation, not standalone instruction.
findings.design_implication: Always pair the spectrogram with a pitch-contour-vs-target line.

findings.name: Vision - developer documentation
findings.claim: Claude reads images as 28x28-px patches, caps standard models at 1568 px long edge, and warns resizing can make text less legible.
findings.design_implication: Render at exactly 1568 px wide; give a semitone whole patch rows.

findings.name: Images and vision - API guide
findings.claim: High-detail pipeline scales the short edge down to 768 px before tiling at 512 px.
findings.design_implication: Budget legibility against a 768-px-high render; keep the aspect wide-and-short.

findings.name: Vision language models are blind
findings.claim: Four SOTA VLMs average 58% on overlapping primitives but reach near-100% when marks are separated by space.
findings.design_implication: The score overlay must be hollow, offset, never superimposed on the harmonic band.

findings.name: riffusion spectrogram_params.py
findings.claim: Riffusion encodes 512 HTK-mel bins to 10 kHz, 10 ms hop, power exponent 0.25, and stores render parameters in PNG EXIF.
findings.design_implication: Emit render parameters as a sidecar; a ^0.25 map is a proven alternative to dB clipping.

findings.name: Deep Salience Representations for F0 Estimation in Polyphonic Music
findings.claim: HCQT: 60 bins/octave (20 cents), 11 ms hop, fmin C1 32.7 Hz, 6 octaves, harmonics {0.5,1,2,3,4,5} stacked.
findings.design_implication: At 20 cents/bin a 50-cent error spans 2.5 bins and is visible without overlay.

findings.name: A Lightweight Instrument-Agnostic Model for Polyphonic Note Transcription and Multipitch Estimation
findings.claim: Basic Pitch uses a CQT at 3 bins/semitone, ~11 ms hop, 7 harmonics + 1 sub-harmonic, scored under MIREX quarter-tone / 50 ms rules.
findings.design_implication: 36 bins/octave is the proven floor for note-level work; 60 is the pitch-gate resolution.

findings.name: Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision
findings.claim: Whisper's input is an 80-channel log-mel at 16 kHz, 25 ms window, 10 ms stride.
findings.design_implication: Log-mel at ~10 ms hop is what LLM-adjacent audio models are trained on: the legibility surface, not the measurement surface.

findings.name: AST: Audio Spectrogram Transformer
findings.claim: AST reaches 0.485 mAP on AudioSet from 128-bin log-mel, 25 ms Hamming, 10 ms shift.
findings.design_implication: 25 ms / 10 ms / 80-128 mel is the de facto standard for what the model hears.

findings.name: Onsets and Frames: Dual-Objective Piano Transcription
findings.claim: SOTA piano transcription ran on 229 log-mel bins (16 kHz, n_fft 2048, hop 512), note F1 82.3 at 50 ms.
findings.design_implication: Mel with many bins is sufficient for onsets and note identity on piano; use 229, not the speech default.

findings.name: Improved Musical Onset Detection with Convolutional Neural Networks
findings.claim: Three stacked log-mels (23/46/93 ms windows, 10 ms hop, 80 bands) reached F 88.5-89.9% at a 25 ms tolerance.
findings.design_implication: A 10 ms hop clears the 40 ms gate with 4x margin; a short-window channel sharpens onsets.

findings.name: Auditory Toolbox - mel_frequencies
findings.claim: Slaney mel is linear below 1 kHz at 200/3 = 66.7 Hz per step, so a 50-cent error at C4 (7.7 Hz) is one-ninth of a filter spacing.
findings.design_implication: Mel alone cannot show the 50-cent gate in the vocal/guitar fundamental range: the decisive argument for a CQT primary.

findings.name: CREPE: A Convolutional Representation for Pitch Estimation
findings.claim: CREPE raw pitch accuracy 0.967 at 50 cents and 0.909 at 10 cents vs pYIN 0.919 / 0.826.
findings.design_implication: Overlay a tracker's f0 in cents-vs-target on the CQT; the picture shows why, the tracker supplies the number.

findings.name: MERT: Acoustic Music Understanding Model with Large-Scale Self-supervised Training
findings.claim: MERT adds a CQT musical teacher beside its codec acoustic teacher to model pitched structure.
findings.design_implication: Even mel/codec music models bolt a CQT back on for pitch; corroborates a two-surface design.

findings.name: Vision Language Models Are Few-Shot Audio Spectrogram Classifiers
findings.claim: GPT-4o on labelled spectrogram images scored 59.0% on ESC-10 vs Gemini-1.5 native audio 49.6%, matching human spectrogram readers (73.75 vs 72.5 on fold 1).
findings.design_implication: The image is a real channel at coarse-category resolution; never a gate.

findings.name: SonicBench: Dissecting the Physical Perception Bottleneck in Large Audio Language Models
findings.claim: Large audio-language models are strong on semantics but unreliable on pitch, timing, loudness and duration.
findings.design_implication: The picture localises; it never measures.

findings.name: Vision Language Models Are Few-Shot Audio Spectrogram Classifiers (ablation)
findings.claim: Ablation (default render = viridis, log frequency, log amplitude, axis labels on, colorbar off -> 27.5% zero-shot): linear frequency axis best (35.0%), linear amplitude 30.0%; magma (25.0%), mel (25.0%), showing a colorbar (23.75%), removing labels (26.25%), low resolution (20.0%) and MFCCs (13.75%) all below the default; few-shot exemplars lifted GPT-4o to 70-76%.
findings.design_implication: Keep axis labels, no colorbar, expose frequency scale and colormap as parameters, ship labelled exemplar plates; neither the MIR-default log render nor magma is automatically best for a VLM.

findings.name: Seeing isn't Hearing: Benchmarking Vision Language Models at Interpreting Spectrograms
findings.claim: Open VLMs read fine-grained speech content off spectrograms at chance (25%); phonetician 75%, ASR 87.6%; adding a waveform did not help.
findings.design_implication: The 50-cent and 40-ms gates never route through the image.

findings.name: Evaluating few-shot prompting for spectrogram-based lung sound classification using a multimodal language model
findings.claim: GPT-4o on real clinical mel spectrograms: 32.0% zero-shot, 36.3% few-shot vs 25% chance.
findings.design_implication: Budget the surface as orientation, not measurement.

findings.name: CaReCoS: A Spectrogram based Visual Benchmark for Cardiac, Respiratory and Cough Sounds
findings.claim: Best of nine current vision/omni models scored 51.2% on mel-spectrogram QA; none combined visual pattern recognition with domain knowledge reliably.
findings.design_implication: Pair the image with a text block of extracted features; domain knowledge is supplied, not assumed.

findings.name: PitchBench: Measuring Pitch Hearing in Audio-Language Models
findings.claim: Audio-language models score 8-48% on pitch across 28 experiments, chords under 20%, and shift with notation (SPN good, Hz bad).
findings.design_implication: Pitch belongs to DSP; when the model states pitch, use note names, never Hz.

findings.name: A Picture is Worth A Thousand Numbers: Enabling LLMs Reason about Time Series via Visualization
findings.claim: Rendering a numeric series as an image instead of dumping numbers improved LLM reasoning ~140% and cut tokens ~99%.
findings.design_implication: Return image + compact numbers, never the raw frame matrix.

findings.name: DEAF: A Benchmark for Diagnostic Evaluation of Acoustic Faithfulness in Audio Language Models
findings.claim: Audio multimodal model predictions are driven mainly by text input even when acoustics contradict it.
findings.design_implication: Blind the critic: describe the render before seeing the intended notes.

findings.name: CharXiv: Charting Gaps in Realistic Chart Understanding in Multimodal LLMs
findings.claim: GPT-4o reads realistic charts at 47.1% vs humans 80.5%.
findings.design_implication: Reading precise values off any plotted axis has a general ceiling.
